run_download_boxoban_levels: run the script to download and extract Boxoban levels from the DeepMind repository
download_boxoban_levels: download Boxoban levels from GitHub and extract them to the minihack data directory
extract_boxoban_zip: extract the downloaded Boxoban levels zip file to the destination path and remove the archive
review_download_boxoban_levels: review the download_boxoban_levels function that uses wget and zipfile to fetch and unpack levels
refactor_download_boxoban_levels: refactor download_boxoban_levels to use requests and urllib instead of os.system wget calls
